parsed.explanation: Locally this is a most-protective division: longstanding public-accommodation anti-discrimination law, gender-identity hate-crime enhancements, X markers on state IDs, and a shield law, with no documented local facility ban, police targeting, or birth-sex ward/custody rule. Those protections mitigate the adverse national regime, but do not erase it. Nationally, passport X issuance has ended, visa officers are instructed to refuse on sex-document discrepancy and consider fraud ineligibility, federal single-sex facilities are restricted to birth sex, and immigration-custody abuse is documented. The border and federal-facility exposures are universal and enforcement of local protections for visitors is not demonstrated, capping the score in the elevated-risk range.
